interpretation: FAIL recorded as-is. Root cause identified, not patched: the real-mode label polygenic term in simulate_labels uses UNALIGNED VCF dosages, which is sign-inverted vs published biology at loci where the VCF alt is the common protective allele (PTPN22 rs2476601, STAT4 rs7574865 — the ADR-004 calibration trap, still present in the label term). The models faithfully learned the inverted simulation signal. Fixing the label term changes the simulation generative model and requires a new ADR cycle; the rejected ADR-005 label design (allele-aligned published betas) already contained the correct mechanism.
